name: @feimacode/open-design-agent-kit-claude-plugin
description: The Open Design Claude Code plugin the repo's marketplace installs: the skills and agent from packages/claude-plugin (copied by `npm run build-local-plugin`) plus a local MCP server. Installed via a Claude Code plugin marketplace, not `npm install`. Its dependencies pin the MCP server, which Claude Code installs from package-lock.json at plugin install time (regenerate with `npm run update-lock`); the devDependency only feeds the generator scripts in the monorepo's sync-content pipeline. packages/claude-plugin is the same plugin with the hosted server, for the Claude plugin directory.
